BIDTYPE.description: Bid type (the bid type saved in relation to constraint ID from FCAS data used in FPP calculations)

CONSTRAINTID.description: Constraint ID (binding constraint ID from FCAS data used in FPP calculations)

INTERVAL_DATETIME.description: Date and time of the trading interval (DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS) fixed to the UTC+10 time zone (NEM time)

REGULATION_MW.description: Enabled regulation MW used in the FPP calculation (from FPP database)

USAGE.description: Usage (calculation of the proportion of regulation FCAS that was calculated to be used)

USAGE_REASON_FLAG.description: The reason flag showing the decision matrix for the usage calculation Supported values are: 0 = Usage is calculated based on good input data 1 = Usage is 0 as FM is unreliable 2 = Usage is 0 as the percentage of units with unavailable input or bad data is greater than the threshold percentage

USAGE_VALUE.description: Usage (calculation of the proportion of regulation FCAS that was calculated to be used)

USED_MW.description: Maximum used regulation MW value (quantity of regulation FCAS that was calculated to be used in MW)

VERSIONNO.description: Version (FPP run number from the FPP database)
